name: minimal-grey-shower-selfie
image_purpose: Bathroom lifestyle selfie and wet-hair visual

prompt.project_info: Create a realistic smartphone selfie inside a modern gray-tiled shower cabin.
prompt.main_subject: One approved adult woman with platinum-blonde hair in a messy bun, dark roots and face-framing strands, large hoop earrings, star necklace, nose piercing, and natural wet skin highlights. She wears a secure black strapless swim top and crouches comfortably while holding the camera above with one arm extended, looking directly toward it.
prompt.composition_elements: 3:4 high-angle smartphone selfie, close-to-medium portrait with most of the body in frame. Include large gray ceramic tiles, glass shower panel, shower controls, towel, subtle glass droplets and condensation, and accurate wide-angle perspective.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Soft diffused bathroom light mixed with gentle overhead highlights, natural wet-skin reflections, cool gray and black palette, minimal clean shower-cabin atmosphere.
prompt.technical_specs: Smartphone wide-lens selfie look, 3:4 portrait, slight natural perspective distortion, face-centered focus, realistic wet hair and skin texture, subtle grain, no artificial smoothing.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: A realistic 3:4 smartphone selfie inside a modern gray-tiled shower cabin. One approved adult woman with platinum-blonde hair in a messy bun, dark roots and face-framing strands wears large hoop earrings, a star necklace, a nose piercing, and a secure black strapless swim top. She crouches comfortably while holding the camera above with one arm extended and looks directly toward it. Include large gray ceramic tiles, a glass shower panel, shower controls, a towel, subtle glass droplets and condensation, natural wet-skin highlights, cool gray and black palette, smartphone wide-angle perspective, and a minimal candid bathroom atmosphere.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, nudity, sexualized pose, fetish framing, child or teen appearance, celebrity likeness, transparent garment, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, over-saturated, airbrushed, HDR look, harsh flash, distorted hands, extra fingers, deformed, random text, watermark, low resolution, blur
